author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I’ll show you how to install a bathroom vanity step by step, including how to prep the cabinet, level the vanity, connect the water lines, install the vanity top, hook up the drain assembly, and test everything for leaks. If you’re doing a DIY bathroom renovation, this is the right way to install a vanity and sink so it’s level, secure, and watertight.
